# School district book bin exchange

The Tamarack Valley school district rotates classroom book bins among its six elementary schools every Friday. A district truck collects the bins, and the school librarians swap them so each classroom sees new titles each month.

The public library is not part of the exchange, though teachers sometimes ask branch staff whether a title in a bin can be placed on hold. It cannot: the bins belong to the district, and their books are not in the library's records.
